name: features-section-demo-2

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows the hovered Ease of use cell with its brighter gradient and blue bar.

tagline: A bordered grid of icon feature cells that glow on hover.
summary: Arranges eight icon-led features in a responsive four-column grid with thin dividers. Each cell shows a line icon, a bold title with a short accent bar and a short description; hovering lights the bar blue.
appearance: A four-by-two grid of feature cells separated by thin dark borders on a near-black page. Each cell carries a small line icon, a bold white title with a short vertical bar to its left, and a few lines of grey copy.
behaviour: Hovering a cell fades in a soft gradient from below, turns its left bar blue and slides the title slightly right. The rest of the grid stays still.
demo_content: Titles like Built for developers, Ease of use, Pricing like no other and 24/7 Customer Support.
use_when: A product page needs a compact icon-led feature grid with a subtle hover cue.
avoid_when: The eight features and icons are hardcoded, and the thin dividers nearly vanish on light themes.
customise: Nothing is exposed; the titles, descriptions and icon choices sit in a local array inside the file.
weight_why: Eight static cells with a CSS hover gradient and one small icon each.

a11y.note: Icons are decorative SVGs with no label, titles are plain divs not headings, and the hover glow has no keyboard equivalent.

issues: The hover glow needs a pointer, so keyboard users never see it.
Feature titles use divs rather than headings, weakening the page outline.
The divider lines are very faint against the dark background.
polish_why: Crisp icons and an even grid; faint borders and a slight hover cue make it feel plain.
